    • getJaxpConfigFactory

      protected String getJaxpConfigFactory(String key)
      Returns the factory class name that jaxpConfigFile configures for the given key, such as javax.xml.transform.TransformerFactory. The JDK reads its configuration file only once per JVM, so a file set after anything in the build has used JAXP is ignored; the plugin therefore passes the factory classes from the file explicitly.
      Parameters:
      key - the factory lookup key
      Returns:
      the factory class name, or null if none is configured
